changes.text: Hand-worked headline checks and explicit UTF-8 and LF output distinguish arithmetic evidence from API consistency.
Configured property precision and open-reference differences are quantified without changing the sizing defaults.
Each route leg supplies its own speed and the thermal summary includes both tank sizes and the consumption boundary.
Sea-passage and port-dwell inventories are compared to expose the additional boil-off allowance.
Supplied powering, insulation and reserve inputs are distinguished from fuel properties and acceptance criteria.
The sea-leg boil-off absorption boundary is shown with the action required above it.
